scope: Hand-integrated synthetic quadrature/factor fixture; boundary levels supplied, not computed from author helpers
manual_derivation: Positive area to t=2 is triangle 1 plus trapezoid 3/4 plus triangle 1/4 =2. Negative strips 2..2.5, 2.5..3, 3..4 have areas -1/4,-3/4,-1. O strip=1, E strip=-1, C strip=-1/4.
controls: O-only changes A1 by -1 and leaves A2 fixed
E-only changes A2 by +1 and leaves A1 fixed
C-only changes A1 by -1/4 and A2 by +1/4, total fixed
Full-window total and A1+A2 agree in every cell
Sum of baseline main, pair and triple Q terms equals SSS-HHH=0; main-only sum=1/2 is wrong
Negating every y reverses both areas and leaves every Q/interaction unchanged
limits: Does not test biological stimulus or source peak/onset derivation
